# Copilot repository instructions

- Use OpenSpec for non-trivial repository changes before editing code or configuration.
- Start discovery with `/opsx-explore` when the change area is unclear.
- Create or update planning artifacts with `/opsx-propose` before implementation.
- Keep `openspec/` artifacts in the same pull request as the code and docs they describe.
- Preserve this repository as a reusable Salesforce DX template and never add org-specific credentials or secrets.
